_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — F5 RED phase (2026-06-17). Tests AC-3: when MULTIPLE candidate tags for one logical concept are present, the producer picks the entry with the most recent end ACROSS ALL present candidate tags — not merely the first tag in the list. The fixture has three revenue tags present with DIFFERENT freshness. The FIRST-listed candidate tag (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax) is intentionally set STALER than the LAST-listed tag (SalesRevenueNet) to confirm the union+max-end logic covers all tags.
_ac3_scenario: The planned _SEC_KEY_CONCEPTS for 'Revenues' lists candidate tags in order: (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet, Revenues). In this fixture, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax has end=2021-12-31 (stale), Revenues has end=2020-12-31 (staler), but SalesRevenueNet (the MIDDLE candidate) has end=2024-12-31 (freshest). The correct producer must union all and pick SalesRevenueNet's 2024 entry.

Revenues_logical_concept._note: SalesRevenueNet (middle in candidate list) has the freshest end. The first-listed candidate tag (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax) is STALER at 2021-12-31. A producer that stops at the first-present tag would return the 2021 entry from RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax. The correct union-then-max-end picks 2024-12-31 from SalesRevenueNet.
